model.title: The skis: {skis}

frontDesk.title: Front desk
frontDesk.description: Today's pickups and returns, and anything overdue.

staffReservations.returnDescription: {customer} has brought back {skis}. The rental ends and {count, plural, one {the ski} other {the skis}} can be booked again. This cannot be undone.
staffReservations.cancelDescription: {customer}'s booking of {skis} for {period} will be cancelled by the store. Use this for a no-show; the customer sees that the store cancelled it.

fleet.count: {count, plural, =0 {No skis} one {# ski} other {# skis}}
fleet.empty: There are no skis in the fleet yet.
fleet.addDescription: A physical pair with its own sticker. Model and length cannot be changed later.
fleet.lengthHint: A different length is a different ski.

errors.inventoryCode: Use letters, digits and dashes, like SK-0142.
errors.length: Enter a length between {min} and {max} cm.

skiDetail.editDescription: Change the inventory code or move the ski to another store. Model and length are fixed.
skiDetail.storeLocked: {count, plural, one {# open reservation expects the ski at its current store, so it cannot move until it is settled.} other {# open reservations expect the ski at its current store, so it cannot move until they are settled.}}
skiDetail.takeOutTitle: Take this ski out of rental?
skiDetail.takeOutDescription: Customers will no longer be able to book it. You can offer it again at any time.
skiDetail.takeOutWithBookings: Customers will no longer be able to book it. {count, plural, one {# booking already made stays valid} other {# bookings already made stay valid}}; cancel them below if the ski is out of service.
skiDetail.outOfRentalNotice: {count, plural, one {This ski is out of rental but # upcoming booking stands. It is honoured; cancel it below if the ski cannot be rented.} other {This ski is out of rental but # upcoming bookings stand. They are honoured; cancel them below if the ski cannot be rented.}}
skiDetail.deleteDescription: The ski leaves the fleet. If it has been rented before, its history stays in the records.
skiDetail.deleteBlocked: {count, plural, one {# reservation is booked or picked up. Settle it before deleting the ski.} other {# reservations are booked or picked up. Settle them before deleting the ski.}}
skiDetail.noReservations: This ski has not been reserved yet.

catalogAdmin.title: Catalogue
catalogAdmin.description: Brands, ski models with their prices, and stores.
catalogAdmin.name: Name
catalogAdmin.priceChangeHint: A new price applies to new bookings. Existing reservations keep the price they were booked at.
catalogAdmin.hoursHint: Write the hours as customers should read them. Leave a day empty when the store is closed.
catalogAdmin.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone. Anything still in use cannot be deleted.
catalogAdmin.ratingsDescription: Comments are visible to staff only. Reply to a customer by e-mail.

errors.name: Enter a name of up to {max} characters.
errors.price: Enter a price like 38 or 38.50, more than zero.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number with the country code, like +421 903 123 456.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.removedCount: {count, plural, one {# removed account} other {# removed accounts}}
accounts.name: Name

accounts.addDescriptionAdmin: Creates a customer or staff account.
accounts.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Share it with the person securely.
accounts.editDescription: Leave the new password empty to keep the current one. Setting one signs the account out everywhere.
accounts.removeDescription: The account is signed out and can no longer sign in. Its reservations stay in the history, and the account can be restored later.

profile.title: Profile
profile.detailsDescription: How you appear to the store.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: You sign in with this address, so it cannot be changed here.
profile.passwordDescription: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

errors.description: This page could not be displayed. Try again, and if it keeps happening, come back a little later.
errors.notFoundDescription: The address may be mistyped, or the page no longer exists.
